nodes.name: Read Contacts (Not Contacted)
nodes.notes:
📊 READ CONTACTS FROM SHEET

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Google Sheets credential
2. Sheet ID
3. Sheet: 'Contacts'
4. Filter: lastContacted = 'Not Yet'

PURPOSE: Read contacts that haven't been reached out to yet

FILTER LOGIC:
- Only new contacts
- lastContacted = 'Not Yet'
- Prevents duplicate outreach

LIMIT: Will process 5-10 contacts per run

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Same Sheet config as previous modules

nodes.name: Limit to 5 Contacts
nodes.notes:
🔢 LIMIT CONTACTS

PURPOSE: Process only 5 contacts per run

WHY LIMIT:
- AI costs (if using OpenAI)
- Processing time
- Manual review capacity
- Quality over quantity

VALIDATION:
- Must have email OR LinkedIn
- Skip contacts with neither

TO ADJUST:
- Change .slice(0, 5) to .slice(0, 10)

RECOMMENDED:
- Start with 5
- Review quality
- Increase if needed

nodes.name: Read Job Details
nodes.notes:
📊 READ JOB DETAILS

PURPOSE: Get full job information to personalize outreach

WHY NEEDED:
- Contact tab has jobId reference
- Need full job details for personalization:
  - Job title
  - Company name
  - Location
  - Key skills
  - Job description

JOIN LOGIC:
- Contact has jobId
- Match to Jobs tab by jobId
- Merge data for AI prompt

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Same Sheet ID, Jobs tab
